task: Make the revised report available in an isolated local container for design review.
nonGoals: Cloudflare release, live model calls, changes to unrelated local applications or committing merchant evidence.

outcomes.description: The local AEO report container serves the revised report with retained audit results and supports selecting tests.
outcomes.evidence: Container status, localhost browser selection and screenshot.

process.description: Keep the local review bundle and retained report private outside source control; use the existing nginx image and a dedicated loopback port.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the report component directly without adding a production-only demo route or dependencies.

exitTest.reason: A local static design review container does not change the agent workflow or portability.
